item.title: Billboard’s 2026 40 Under 40 List Revealed
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest trends and insights from the music industry. Today, we're talking about Billboard's 40 Under 40 list, which highlights the most influential young executives in the business.
[Soft music transitions]
Host: This list is unique in that each honoree can only appear once, making it a highly competitive and prestigious recognition. With hundreds of nominations, the editors at Billboard have their work cut out for them. But what's heartening is the constant influx of new talent in the industry.
[Music swells]
Host: This year's list is led by Hilary Gleason, co-founder and executive director of Backline, a nonprofit dedicated to providing mental health and wellness resources to music industry professionals. She's joined by 39 other executives who are shaping the music business today and guaranteeing its prosperity tomorrow.
[Short music transition]
Host: Take Tom Allen, chief technology officer at Virgin Music Group, who co-founded Curve Royalty Systems and has been responsible for overseeing technology across Virgin. Or Shirin Nury, an agent at CAA, who's behind the arena-level touring careers of artists like Gracie Abrams and Tate McRae.
[Music fades out]
Host: We also have Juan S. Arenas, president of global HYBE label services, who's helping build the infrastructure for artists and labels to thrive globally. These young leaders are driving innovation and creativity in the industry, and their passion for music is what sets them apart.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. If you want to learn more about Billboard's 40 Under 40 list, check out the full article on their website. Until next time, stay tuned for more insights and trends from the music industry.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
